query:
SELECT
                channel as "channel!",
                COALESCE(SUM(CAST(estimated_payment_amount AS DECIMAL)), 0) as "revenue!: rust_decimal::Decimal",
                COUNT(*) as "count!"
            FROM admin.meta_orders
            WHERE order_status != 'CANCELED'
              AND created_time >= $1::date
              AND created_time < ($2::date + INTERVAL '1 day')
            GROUP BY channel
